eyebrow: A real mechanism: Claude Agent SDK subagents
code:
Main agent invokes a subagent for a focused subtask.
Subagent runs with SEPARATE context from the main agent --
only its distilled outcome comes back, not every
intermediate search result along the way.

Defined programmatically, as markdown files, or built-in.
caption: Separate context is the actual point, not an implementation detail.

code:
Splitting work doesn't remove complexity --
it moves it into coordination:
  who talks to whom, in what order,
  who resolves it if the reviewer rejects the draft.

Worth it when roles are genuinely separable.
caption: Earns its complexity on clean hand-offs, not just "feels big."

subtitle: One common way to organize that coordination.
